title: 2002 Porsche 911 GT2
variant: 2002 996 GT2 road car with the six-speed manual, distinct from the contemporary all-wheel-drive Turbo and naturally aspirated GT3.

model.engine: ESS acceleration v2 (integration/ess-converged 9f4a292); launch presets not promoted (PR #18 QA-FAIL)

cg.basis: Typical low sports car. No ESS measurement. —  Indicative range 16–20.

frontTrack.basis: As published by Supercar X (2004–08); not re-verified.

rearTrack.basis: As published by Supercar X (2004–08); not re-verified.

grip.basis: Extreme-performance summer tire (C5 Z06 class) (tire-type default; see acceleration validation).

cda.basis: Typical modern sports car Cd 0.30–0.36 × 19–21 ft². —  Indicative range 5.5–7.5.

frontSpring.basis: Spring giving a typical 1.6 Hz front ride frequency (sports).

rearSpring.basis: Spring giving a typical 1.8 Hz rear ride frequency (sports).

frontMotion.basis: MacPherson strut (incl. modified strut, coil on lower arm). Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 0.85–1.

rearMotion.basis: Independent multilink / integral link. Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 0.6–0.9.

frontUnsprung.basis: MacPherson strut (incl. modified strut, coil on lower arm). Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 70–100.

rearUnsprung.basis: Independent multilink / integral link. Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 75–105.

tireRate.basis: Typical tire vertical rate for the vehicle type. —  Indicative range 1000–2400.

front.basis: As published by Supercar X (2004–08); not re-verified.

wheelbase.basis: As published by Supercar X (2004–08); not re-verified.

hpRpm.basis: As published by Supercar X (2004–08); not re-verified.

torqueRpm.basis: As published by Supercar X (2004–08); not re-verified.

redline.basis: Peak-power rpm × 1.067 (Supercar X archive median, 64 cars; range ×1.00–1.16). —  Indicative range 5700–6600.

gears.basis: As published by Supercar X (2004–08); not re-verified.

finalDrive.basis: As published by Supercar X (2004–08); not re-verified.

diameter.basis: 315/30ZR-18: Nominal unloaded diameter from the size; loaded radius is smaller.

archFront.basis: Mapped from the record's suspension text.

archRear.basis: Mapped from the record's suspension text.

spring-rate.estimated: Front spring (lb/in), Rear spring (lb/in), Front motion ratio, Rear motion ratio, Front unsprung (lb/corner), Rear unsprung (lb/corner), Tire vertical rate (lb/in)

quarter.estimated: CG height (in), Upshift RPM (model shift point, not the rev limit), Launch grip coefficient, Drag area (ft²)

oval.estimated: CG height (in), Upshift RPM (model shift point, not the rev limit), Launch grip coefficient, Drag area (ft²)
